title: OfferResolved
description: One driver's instant offer ended. One event per driver per offer; it feeds the driver's acceptance rate.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, a random UUID stamped by goway-lib-rs when it publishes. Consumers dedupe on it.

outcome.title: OfferResolution
outcome.description: `accepted`: the driver took it. `lost`: they accepted but another driver was first. `declined`: they skipped it. `expired`: no answer in time. `withdrawn`: the load was taken by someone else, cancelled or edited before they answered.
